headline: Approved budget transfers of $194,408.75 and $73,904.24 and new rules for payments and final invoices.
summary: A request from 222 East Main Street for a bill reduction and penalty waiver ended with a payment plan offer instead. Members revised the policy on processing payments and adopted closing procedures for final invoices. They also approved transfers to cover over expenditures in the 2025/2026 Budget.
decisions: Approved the July 21, 2026 regular meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved the August 5, 2026 special meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved the July 2026 Department Reports, unanimously.
Offered 222 East Main Street a payment plan on its large balance, with no recourse given, unanimously.
Approved revisions to the Department Policy on Processing Payments, unanimously.
Adopted closing procedures for calculating final invoices, unanimously.
Approved transfers of $194,408.75 from Capital Outlay and $73,904.24 from Program Supplies to cover over expenditures, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of Commissioner Dunn and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the July 21, 2026 regular meeting minutes as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 5, 2026 special meeting minutes as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Cunningham and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the July 2026 Department Reports as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Cunningham and seconded; it was unanimously voted that no recourse be given to 222 East Main Street, but to offer a payment plan on the large balance.
On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the proposed changes for the Department Policy on Processing Payments as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Dunn and seconded; it was unanimously voted to adopt the Closing Procedures for Calculating Final Invoices as presented.
On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to bring to the table and to approve the transfers to fund over expenditures in the 2025/2026 Budget as presented.

decision_titles: Bill reduction request at 222 East Main Street
